The 2026 Winter 2v2 Tournament is the first OFM event of the year, serving as a community single edition tournament where teams of 2 face each other.

About

Format

  • General Information
    • 2v2 community event
    • Free registration
    • Maximum of 32 teams
    • 25 minutes cap
  • Group Stage - 24th of January, 2026
    • 8 random pools of 3 teams
    • Round-robin format: every team plays every other team twice
    • 6 matches per pool
      • Win = 1 point
      • Loss = 0 points
    • The team with the most points in each pool qualifies for finals
  • Playoff - 25th of January, 2026
    • 8 qualified teams
    • Random single-elimination bracket
    • 8 total matches
    • Losing a match results in immediate elimination
    • A Third Place Match is played between the losers of the Semi-Finals
    • The Final ends in a Bo3
  • Prize Pool
    • Pattern rewards
    • 2 free shop skin of choice
    • One custom OpenFront Masters skin
